steps.code:
# Parse the note content to extract song and artist pairs
content = note_content['content']
lines = content.split('\n')[1:]  # skip the header line
songs = []
for line in lines:
    if line.strip():
        # Split on " by " to get song and artist part
        if ' by ' in line:
            song_part, artist_part = line.split(' by ', 1)
            songs.append({'song': song_part.strip(), 'artists': artist_part.strip()})
        else:
            # If no " by ", maybe just song name? But format seems consistent.
            songs.append({'song': line.strip(), 'artists': ''})
print(songs)

    if ' by ' in line:
        title, artists = line.split(' by ', 1)
        songs_raw.append((title.strip(), artists.strip()))

        # If no 'by', treat whole line as title
